boundary: The same actual radical gives a roots-of-unity character with exactly the original kernel. Its factorization transports inverse-character conjugation, and actual cyclotomic root action supplies the second character factor. The conjugate radical ratio descends to the same F=Q(zeta_p); actual base automorphisms lift internally. The original nonzero Kummer class in F^*/(F^*)^p and its nonzero F_p vector satisfy omega^2 transformation for every base automorphism. This quotient is not the ideal class group. Integralization, ideal valuations and local arithmetic, class-group/unit maps and vanishing, resonant-place geometry and tower iteration remain open; general hno is unfinished.
